title: Howling Cosmic Wolf
description: A luminous white and grey wolf howls upward from a mound of broken clock faces and golden rings. The dark background is fractured like shattered glass, with floating clock parts, keys, and swirling smoke against a starry void.
prompt: A majestic white wolf howling at the cosmos, emerging from a pile of broken antique clock faces and golden rings. The dark background is fractured like shattered glass with floating clock mechanisms, keys, and swirling smoke. Ethereal glowing eyes, intricate symbolic details, surreal dreamlike atmosphere, high contrast, mystical and melancholic mood.
